snippet.title: Hearth Bound Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Hearth Bound - Releasing April 2026
Wishlist Now On Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4428980/Hearth_Bound/

Press Kit: 
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sN86TpHohawoXqA8NofQRaKgN9bPpzxX?usp=sharing

Multiplayer Cozy Home Building Game.

Build and decorate a cozy fantasy home together. Place furniture, discover new decor, and expand your shared hearth as you design rooms side-by-side with friends in a relaxing co-op building experience.
------------------------------------------------------------
- Cozy co-op home building for you and your friends
- Hundreds of fantasy-inspired furnishings and decorations
- Powerful placement tools: move, rotate, scale, snap,  and Room - Expansion!
- Build cozy cottages, tavern rooms, gardens, workshops, and more
Capture and share beautiful screenshots of your creations

Early Access Roadmap
- Progression through discovery - place objects to unlock new furniture and categories
- More Key Bound Actions - recolor, duplicate, undo
- More Catalog Management - Custom Named Collections and Multi-Prop Preset management
- More Assets - Room Sets, Profession Sets
- More Pets
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This game was started live on Youtube Streaming over at UX is Fine youtube channel - checkout the start from 3 weeks ago here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KFtWHzJsj5I&t=11s
